name: Half-Eaten USB Drive
flavorText: Contains someone's tax returns from 2004 and a 96kbps MP3 of Darude Sandstorm. Still slightly chew-marked.

name: Soggy Calculus Homework
flavorText: Conclusive proof that the dog didn't eat it; the river did. Received a damp B-minus.

name: Solo Left Lime-Green Croc
flavorText: In 'Sport Mode'. Missing its right companion, but harbors a tiny colony of barnacles.

name: Left AirPod (Seaweed Wrap)
flavorText: Somehow still playing a podcast at 2% battery. The host is talking about cryptocurrency.

name: Floppy Disk (Doom Installer 3/5)
flavorText: Disk 3 of 5. Without the other four, humanity remains in perpetual suspense.

name: Mysterious Green Button
flavorText: Labeled: 'DO NOT PUSH UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCE'. It has clearly been pressed 4,200 times.

name: Traffic Cone of Destiny
flavorText: Radiates an authoritative aura that redirects interdimensional pedestrian traffic.

name: Sentient Gas Station Squeegee
flavorText: Dripping with mysterious blue fluid. Whispers quiet cleaning advice when left unattended.

name: Unwound Synthwave Cassette
flavorText: Magnetic tape tangled like spaghetti. You can hear nostalgic drum machines if you hold it to your ear.

name: RGB Gamer Spatula
flavorText: Flipping pancakes at 144Hz with full Chroma synchronisation. Requires 3 AAA batteries.

name: Pulley-Equipped Rubber Chicken
flavorText: A legendary tool of retro pirate scoundrels. Makes an ear-splitting honk when pulled.

name: Cursed Bowling Pin
flavorText: Knocks itself down at 3:00 AM every Tuesday. The lacquer smells like impending doom.

name: Unbreakable Brick Phone
flavorText: Zero scratches despite spending 18 years on the riverbed. Battery is still at 78%. Snake game paused.

name: Tactical Cyber-Gnome MK-IV
flavorText: Equipped with night-vision monocle and a tiny titanium spade. Guards the canal with grim determination.

name: Quantum Bagel Toaster
flavorText: The toast is simultaneously burnt and frozen until observed by the hungry diner.

name: Key to Bunker Y2K
flavorText: Stamped December 31, 1999. Inside is likely just 50,000 canned beans and spam tins.

name: 56k Dial-Up Shocker Box
flavorText: Still shrieking the terrifying song of 1998 connectivity. Scares off all real fish instantly.
